author: Krono III
title: Attention Arc 1: Multi-Head Attention (4 Heads)
abstract: This experiment begins a new research arc focused on improving the SOTA architecture's most critical component: attention. I have implemented a Multi-Head Attention mechanism to allow the network to focus on multiple spatial patterns simultaneously. I hypothesize this will improve performance over the single-head baseline. This first test uses 4 attention heads.
